verses.text: رَضِيتُ عَنِ الْمَوْلَى تَعَالَى الَّذِى رَبَّى
verses.transcription: radiitu hannil mawlaa tahaalal lazii rabbaa
fu-aadii wa aghnaanii wa akrim bihi rabbaa

verses.text: بِهِ قَدْ غَنِتُ الْيَوْمَ عَبْدًا لَّهُ بِهِ
verses.transcription: bihi qad ghanitul yawma habdan lahu bihi
khadiiman dawaman lil lazikh taarahu hibbaa

verses.text: بِهِ قَدْ غَنِيتُ الْيَوْمَ عَبْدًا بِذِكْرِهِ
verses.transcription: bihi qad ghaniitul yawma habdan bizikrihi
wa hannii yakuqqul hara wan naara was sabbaa
nabaztul laghaa lil laahi habdan murattilan

verses.text: لِذِكْرٍ حَكِيمٍ عَنْ جَنَابِى الْعِدَى ذَبَّا
verses.transcription: lizikrin hakiimin han janaabil hidaa zabbaa
urattiluhu maadumtu hayyan wa aktafii

verses.text: وَأَنْفِى بِهِ إِبْلِيسَ عَنِّى مَتِى دَبَّا
verses.transcription: wa anfii bihi ibliisa hannii matii dabbaa
ilayhi tijaa-ii wahwa mughnin wa waasihun

verses.text: لَّهُ الْمُلْكُ ثُمَّ الْحَمْدُ وَالْحَالُ قَدْ ثَبَّا
verses.transcription: lahul mulku summal hamdu wal haalu qad sabbaa

verses.text: خَرَجْتُ بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ مِنْ كُلِّ بَاطِلٍ
verses.transcription: kharajtu bifadlil laahi min kulli baatilin
wa faaraqtu tadbiiri bihid dafha wal jalbaa
radiitu bihi rabban kariiman mukarriiman
waqaanil hidaa wal harba wal bahra wat talbaa
jazaa-ii halal mawlaa biraddii zawil firaa
wa lii wajjahuu maalan bitaskhirihi salbaa
nawaytu hunar rujhaa lituubaa bi-iznihi
wa awdahtuhu jismii wa awdahtuhul qalbaa

verses.text: إِلَى اللَّهِ وَالْمُخْتَارِ هَاجَرْتُ مِنْ مَّلَا
verses.transcription: ilal laahi wal mukhtaari haajartu min malaa

verses.text: عِبَادَا تُهُمْ عِصْيَانُ رَبِّ أَلْوَرَى الْبَا
verses.transcription: hibaadaa tuhum hisyaanu rabbil waraa albaa
maraamiya yuhtiinihi rabbun muqaddimun

verses.text: قَدِيمٌ لَّهُ مُلْكٌ حَوَى الشَّرْقَ وَالْغَرْبَا
verses.transcription: qadiimun lahu mulkun hawash sharqa wal gharbaa
najaatii minal ahdaa-i wal bahri wal balaa

verses.text: غَرِيبًا وَحِيدًا مِّنْ حَفِيظٍ مَّلَا الْجُرْبَا
verses.transcription: ghariiban wa hiidan min hafiizin malal jurbaa

verses.text: هَدَانِى تَعَالَى بَعْدَ مَا كِدْتُّ هَالِكًا
verses.transcription: hadaanii tahaalaa bahda maa kidtu haalikan

verses.text: بِجَاهِ الَّذِى قَدْ زَيَّنَ الْعُجْمَ وَالْعُرْبَا
verses.transcription: bijaahil lazii qad zayyanal hujma wal hurbaa
unaajiihi fii sirrin wa jahrin wa artajii
salaahii wa islaahii bihil ahla wat tirbaa

verses.text: ذَلِلْتُ لَهُ لَا لِلْعِدَى ثُمَّ كَانَ لِى
verses.transcription: zaliltu lahu laa lil hidaa summa kaana lii
wa kanzi kitaabun hubbuhu yakshiful  karbaa
hadaanii bihi rabbii wa ahdii  binuurihi
izaa shaa-ahu rabbi zawil buhdii wal qurbaa
ilaahii ilaa tuubaaya qudnii wa salliman
wa jud bimtinaanin samma waltuuminit turbaa

verses.text: لَكَ الْبَرُّ وَالْبَحْرُ الَّذِى قُدْ تَّنِى لَهُ
verses.transcription: lakal barru wal bahrul lazii qud tanii lahu

verses.text: قَفِى الْبَرِّ هَبْ لِى الْأَمْنَ وَلْتُكْرِمِ الْجَنبَا
verses.transcription: qafil barri hab lil amna waltukrimil janbaa

verses.text: قُلُوبَ الْعِدَى قَلِّبْ إِلَى مَا يَسُرُّنِى
verses.transcription: quluubal hidaa qallib ilaa maa yasurrunii
wa bii bashsharil akhyaara waltaghfiriz zanbaa
rajawtu firaaqii sarmadan jumlatal hidaa

verses.text: وَلُقْيَى عِيَالِى مِنْكَ يَامَنْ قَضَى الْأَرْبَا
verses.transcription: wa lugh-yaa hiyaalii minka yaa man qadal arbaa
yuqallibu qahrun minka rabbi quluubahum

verses.text: فَلِى كُنْ بِكُنْ رَّبِّ وَلِى وَسِّعِ الزِّرْبَا
verses.transcription: falii kun bikun rabbi wa lii wassihiz zirbaa
tafaddl halayyal yawma yaa rabbi bil munaa
bifat-hin wa faydin yukhjilul wabla munsabbaa
ilayka wa lil mukhtaari haajartu bil hudaa
wa bis sunnatil baydaa-i yaa man waqat tabbaa

verses.text: لِىَ اصْرِقْ كُءُوسَ الْقَوْمِ وَلْتَسْقِنِى بِهَا
verses.transcription: liyasriq ku-uusal qawmi waltasqinii bihaa

verses.text: وَوَسِّعْ وَهَبْ لِى الْمَصَّ يَارَبِّ وَالْعَبَّا
verses.transcription: wa wassih wa hab lil massa yaa rabbi wal habbaa
zalaamiya bil misbaahi hanii jalawtahaa

verses.text: عَلَيْهِ صَلَاةٌ مِّنْكَ أَحْوِ بِهَا الْحُبَّا
verses.transcription: halayhi salaatun minka ahwi bihal hubbaa
azalta bihi kibrii wa hujbii murabiiyan
halayhi salaamun minka yakfiiniyal khibbaa

verses.text: لَقَدْ سُقْتَ لِى فِى الْبَحْرِ مَا كُنْتُ أَرْتَجِى
verses.transcription: laqad suqta lii fil bahri maa kuntu artajii
bijaahil lazii sayyartahul khilla wal hibbaa

verses.text: مَحَوْتَ بِهِ عَيْبِى فَقُدْنِى مِنَ الْعِدَى
verses.transcription: mahawta bihi haybii faqudnii minal hidaa

verses.text: إِلَى إِخْوَتِى وَاجْعَلْ رُجُوعِى لَنَا طِبَّا
verses.transcription: ilaa ikhwatii wajhal rujuuhii lanaa tibbaa

verses.text: أَجَرْتَ الَّذِى قَدْ كَانَ يَرْجُو إِجَارَةً
verses.transcription: ajartal lazii qad kanaa yarjuu ijaaratan
fazidhul hudaa wal hilma wal takfihil hujbaa

verses.text: هَدَيْتَ الَّذِى قَدْ كَانَ يُرْدِيهِ جَهْلَهُ
verses.transcription: hadaytal lazii qad kaana yurdiihi jahlahu
fahanhuk shifil astaara yaa rabbii wal hujbaa
lakash shuqru war ridwaanu wal hamdu sarmadan

verses.text: وَلَاشَكَّ لِى فِى كَوْنِكَ اللَّهَ وَالرَّبَّا
verses.transcription: walaa shakka lii fii kawnikal laaha war rabbaa
hajartul laghaa biz zikri wash shukri musniyan

verses.text: عَلَى الْمُصْطَفَى مَنْ جُودُهُ نَحْوِىَ انْصَبَّا
verses.transcription: halal mustafaa man juuduhu nahwiyan sabbaa
ayal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa man aghastanii

verses.text: فَصَلِّ بِتَسْلِيمٍ عَلَى خَيْرِ مَنْ لَّبَّى
verses.transcription: fasalli bitasliimin halaa khayri man labbaa
wa siqtu wa kun lii bil muqaffaa wa aalihi

verses.text: وَأَصْحَابِهِ مَنْ أَخْجَلُواْ اللَّيْثَ إِذْ قَبَّا
verses.transcription: wa as-haabihi man akhjalul laysa iz qabbaa

verses.text: أُنِيلُواْ ثَوَابَ اللَّهِ فِى كُلِّ غَزْوَةٍ
verses.transcription: uniiluu sawaabal laahi fii kullii ghazwatin
mahal hubbi wa ridwaani wal qurbi wal qurbaa
jihaadahumul ahmaalu haqqan wa kulluhum
yubashshiruhul maahii izaa haayanal harbaa
halayhim minal mawlaa ridaa-un wa rahmatun
kamaa zahzahuu hannii bi as-yaafihim taghbaa

verses.text: لِىَ اجْعَلْ بِهِمْ يَا مَالِكِى خَيْرَ مَخْرَجٍ
verses.transcription: liyajhal bihim yaa maalikii khayra makhrajin
wa tayyib wa sallim wam nunan waltazid raghbaa

verses.text: لَهُ اكْتُبْ صَلَاةً مَّعْ سَلَامٍ بِهِمْ مَّعًا
verses.transcription: lahuktub salaatan mah sallamin bihim mahan

verses.text: وَهَبْ لِى بِهِمْ يَا مَالِكِى الطَّىَّ وَالْجَذْبَا
verses.transcription: wa hab lii bihim yaa maalikit tayya wal jazbaa
nabaztul lazii qad bihtuhu faltubaddilan
wa jannibniyal ihjaaba wal kibra wal kizbaa
inilnii karaamaatin wa kun lii bilan tihaa

verses.text: بِمَا فَاقَ ظَنِّى وَلْتُسَخِّرْ لِىَ الصَّعْبَا
verses.transcription: bimaa faaqa zannii wal tusakhkhir liyas sahbaa
madadttu yadii yaa maalikii raajiyan lakum
ghariiban muniiban annisan wakshifir ruhbaa

verses.text: نَفَيْتَ الْأَذَى عَنِّى فَجُدْ لِى بِأَوْبَتِى
verses.transcription: nafaytal azaa hannii fajud lii bi-awbatii

verses.text: سَرِيعًا بِلَا كَدٍّ وَلِى وَسِّعِ اللَّحْبَا
verses.transcription: sariihan bilaa kaddin wa lii wassihil lahbaa

verses.text: لَكَ الشُّكْرُ إِذْ صَيَّرْ تَنِى خَادِمَ النَّبِى
verses.transcription: lakash shukru iz sayyar tanii khaadiman nabii

verses.text: عَلَيْهِ صَلَاةٌ مِّنْكَ تُعْلِى بِهَا الصَّحْبَا
verses.transcription: halayhi salaatun minka tuhlii bihas sahbaa
dahawtuka bil mukhtaari bil aali kullihim
wa as-haabihi yaa man kafaanii bihim shisbaa

verses.text: نَفَيْتَ بِهِمْ عَنِّى الْأَذَى ثُمَّ كُنْتَ لِى
verses.transcription: nafayta bihim hannil azaa summa kunta lii

verses.text: فَلِى طَيِّبِ الرُّجْعَى وَلِى خَلِّدِ الْخِصْبَا
verses.transcription: falii tayyibir rujhaa wa lii khallidil khisbaa
kafayta zawit tasliisi hannii wa adbaruu
furadii wa masnii wakfiniihim bihim da-baa
wasiqtu bikal lahumma  sawlii maraaghibii
dawaaman bijaahil mustafaa wakfinil ka-baa

verses.text: لَهُ اكْتُبْ صَلَاةً مَّعْ سَلَامٍ بِئَالِهِ
verses.transcription: lahuktub salaatan mah salaamin bi-aalihi
wa as-haabihi wajhal bihi masjidi rahbaa
yubashshiruhu zannil lazii qaadanii ilaa

verses.text: دُعَآءٍ فَبَشِّرْ مَنْ أَطَالُواْ لِىَ النَّحْبَا
verses.transcription: duhaa-in fabashshir man ataaluu liyan nahbaa
yubashshiruhu hilmi bikawnika qaadiran

verses.text: عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ لِّى اسْتَجِبْ وَالْفِنِى النَّكْبَا
verses.transcription: halaa kulli shay-in lis tajib wal finiin nakbaa
ajib dahwatii wajjih quyuudan likalkalii
wa khallid quyuudaati walaa tatrukis sakbaa
wasiqtu bibaaqin qaahirin qaadirin lahu
fu-aadii wa jusmaanii wa lii yaqbalul kisbaa

verses.text: أُدِيمُ لَهُ مَاعِشْتُ إِنْ شَآ عِبَادَةً
verses.transcription: udiimu lahu maa histu in shaa hibadatan
wa arjuu qabuulan minhu qad tuurisul wisbaa
jahaltu kitaabal laahi wirdii wa abtaghii

verses.text: بِتَرْتِيلِهِ مَا شِأْتُ إِصَارَ لِى أَبَّا
verses.transcription: bitartiilihi maa si-tu isaara lii abbaa
halayya lirabbii daynu tartiili aa-yihi

verses.text: وَإِنِّى إِلَى قَوْمِى أَءُوبُ بِهِ أَبَّا
verses.transcription: wa innii ilaa qawmii a-uubu bihi abbaa

verses.text: لِرَبِّىَ أَحْمَدِى ثُمَّ شُكْرِ بِلَا انْتِهًا
verses.transcription: lirabbiya ahmadii summa shukri bilan tihan

verses.text: عَلَى جَعْلِ صَدْرِ ظَرْفَ ءَايَاتِهِ حِزْبَا
verses.transcription: halaa jahli sadri zarfa aayaatihi hizbaa

verses.text: لَهُ جَلَّ شُكْرِى بَعْدَ حَمْدِ وَكَانَ لِى
verses.transcription: lahu jalla shukrii bahda hamdi wa kanaa lii

verses.text: وَلِى رَاضَ أَعْدَآءً نَحَوْا جَانِبِى حِزْبَا
verses.transcription: wa lii raada ahdaa-an nahaw jaanibii hizbaa

verses.text: نَجَوْتُ بِحِفْظِ اللَّهِ مِنْ سَطْوَةِ الْعِدَى
verses.transcription: najawtu bihifzil laahi min satwatil hidaa

verses.text: وَلِى رَاضَهُمْ طُرًا وَلِى كَرَّمَ الْجَنْبَا
verses.transcription: wa lii raadahum turran wa lii karramal janbaa

verses.text: أَغَاثَنِىَ الْحَنَّانُ مِنْ كَيْدِ مَنْ قَلَى
verses.transcription: aghaasaniyal hannaanu min kaydi man qalaa

verses.text: وَصَارَ كَنَارِ الْخِلِّ لِى بَحْرُ مَايُنبَا
verses.transcription: wa saara kanaaril khilli lii bahru maayunbaa
midaadii wa aqlaamii wa lawhii wa kalkalii

verses.text: وَجِسْمِى لِمَنْ لِّى وَجَّهَ الْحِفْظَا وَالْوَهْبَا
verses.transcription: wa jismanii liman lii wajjahal hifzaa wal wahbaa

verses.text: نَوَيْتُ لَهُ شُكْرًا كَثِيرًا كَمَا حَمَى
verses.transcription: nawaytu lahu shukran kasiiran kamaa hamaa
janaabii wa astakfiihi yawmal jawal lahbaa

verses.text: لَهُ جَلَّ شُكْرِى إِذْ هَدَانِى بِفَضْلِهِ
verses.transcription: lahu jalla shukrii iz hadaanii bifadlihi

verses.text: وَجَاهِ الَّذِى مَدْحِى لَهُ صَارَ لِى عَضْبَا
verses.transcription: wa jaahil lazii madhii lahu saara lii hadbaa

verses.text: دَعَانِى إِلَى دَارِ السَّلَامِ الَّتِى بِهَا
verses.transcription: dahaanii ilaa daaris salaamil latii bihaa
unaajiihi biz zikril lazii tayyabal qalbaa
nafaa hanniyash shaytaana wallaa bikaydihi

verses.text: وَأَبْغِى نَجَاةً مِّنْهُ مِنْهُ مَتِى دَبَّا
verses.transcription: wa abghii najaatan minhu minhu matii dabbaa
kafaanii hafiizun qaahirun maanihun hunaa
shukuukan wa waswaasan wa hannil hidaa zabbaa
nawaytu rujuuhan zaa salaatin musalliman

verses.text: عَلَى الْمُصْطَفَى الْمَاحِى الَّذِى اخْتَارَهُ حِبَّا
verses.transcription: halal mustafal maahil lazikh taraahu hibbaa
salaatun wa tasliimun halal mustafan nabii

verses.text: مَعَ الْئَالِ وَالْأَصْحَابِ مِمَّنْ نَّفَى الْخِبَّا
verses.transcription: mahal aali wal as-haabi mimman nafal khibbaa
yusallii bitasliimin halayhi bi aalihi
wa as-haabihi rabbun hafiizun kafaa tabbaa
rahiimun shakuurun artajii minhu rafhahu
ilayhi makaatiibii wa akrim bihi rabbaa
usallii bitasliimin halayhi liwajhi man

verses.text: يَّسُوقُ بِهِ لِى مَااعْتَمَى لِى كَمَا رَبَّى
verses.transcription: yasuuqu bihi lii mahtamaa lii kamaa rabbaa

bayts.text: رَضِيتُ عَنِ الْمَوْلَى تَعَالَى الَّذِى رَبَّى ۞ فُؤَادِى وَأَغْنَانِى وَأَكْرِمْ بِهِ رَبَّا

translations.it.karamati: Sono compiaciuto del Signore, l'Altissimo, che ha educato il mio cuore e mi ha arricchito; e quanto è generoso Egli come Signore!
translations.en.karamati: I am well pleased with the Master, the Exalted, Who has nurtured my heart and enriched me; and how generous He is as Lord!
translations.fr.karamati: Je suis satisfait du Maître, le Très-Haut, qui a éduqué mon cœur et m'a enrichi ; et combien Il est généreux comme Seigneur !

bayts.text: بِهِ قَدْ غَنِتُ الْيَوْمَ عَبْدًا لَّهُ بِهِ ۞ خَدِيمًا دَوَامً لِلَّذِى اخْتَارَهُ حِبَّا

translations.it.karamati: Per mezzo di Lui sono divenuto oggi ricco, servo Suo, per mezzo di Lui servitore perennemente di colui che Egli ha scelto come amato.
translations.en.karamati: Through Him I have become rich today, His slave, through Him a servant perpetually of the one He chose as beloved.
translations.fr.karamati: Par Lui je suis devenu aujourd'hui riche, Son serviteur, par Lui serviteur perpétuellement de celui qu'Il a choisi comme bien-aimé.

bayts.text: بِهِ قَدْ غَنِيتُ الْيَوْمَ عَبْدًا بِذِكْرِهِ ۞ وَعَنِّى يَكُقُّ الْعَرَ وَالنَّارَ وَالسَّبَّا

translations.it.karamati: Per mezzo di Lui sono divenuto oggi ricco, servo, con il Suo ricordo, e da me Egli trattiene la vergogna, il Fuoco e l'ingiuria.
translations.en.karamati: Through Him I have become rich today, a slave, by His remembrance, and from me He holds back disgrace, the Fire and insult.
translations.fr.karamati: Par Lui je suis devenu aujourd'hui riche, serviteur, par Son rappel, et de moi Il retient la honte, le Feu et l'insulte.

bayts.text: نَبَذْتُ اللَّغَى لِلَّهِ عَبْدًا مُّرَتِّلًا ۞ لِذِكْرٍ حَكِيمٍ عَنْ جَنَابِى الْعِدَى ذَبَّا

translations.it.karamati: Ho rigettato la vanità per Allah, servo che recita lentamente un Ricordo saggio (il Corano): Egli ha respinto i nemici dalla mia parte.
translations.en.karamati: I have cast away idle talk for Allah, a slave reciting slowly a wise Remembrance (the Qurʾān): He has driven the enemies from my side.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai rejeté la vanité pour Allah, serviteur récitant posément un Rappel sage (le Coran) : Il a repoussé les ennemis de mon côté.

bayts.text: أُرَتِّلُهُ مَادُمْتُ حَيًّا وَأَكْتَفِى ۞ وَأَنْفِى بِهِ إِبْلِيسَ عَنِّى مَتِى دَبَّا

translations.it.karamati: Lo recito lentamente finché sono vivo e me ne accontento, e per mezzo di esso respingo Iblīs da me quando si insinua.
translations.en.karamati: I recite it slowly as long as I live and am content with it, and through it I drive Iblīs from me whenever he creeps.
translations.fr.karamati: Je le récite posément tant que je suis vivant et je m'en contente, et par lui je repousse Iblīs de moi quand il s'insinue.

bayts.text: إِلَيْهِ تِجَاءِى وَهْوَ مُغْنٍ وَوَاسِعٌ ۞ لَّهُ الْمُلْكُ ثُمَّ الْحَمْدُ وَالْحَالُ قَدْ ثَبَّا

translations.it.karamati: Verso di Lui è il mio rifugio, ed Egli è Colui che arricchisce, l'Immenso; a Lui il regno e poi la lode, e lo stato si è già reso saldo.
translations.en.karamati: To Him is my refuge, and He is the Enricher, the All-Embracing; His is the dominion and then the praise, and the state has already become firm.
translations.fr.karamati: Vers Lui est mon refuge, et Il est Celui qui enrichit, l'Immense ; à Lui le royaume puis la louange, et l'état s'est déjà affermi.

bayts.text: خَرَجْتُ بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ مِنْ كُلِّ بَاطِلٍ ۞ وَفَارَقْتُ تَدْبِيرِ بِهِ الدَّفْعَ وَالْجَلْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Sono uscito, per la grazia di Allah, da ogni falsità, e mi sono separato dal mio (proprio) disporre, per mezzo di Lui, nel respingere e nell'attirare.
translations.en.karamati: I have come out, by the grace of Allah, from every falsehood, and parted from my (own) planning, through Him, in repelling and attracting.
translations.fr.karamati: Je suis sorti, par la grâce d'Allah, de toute fausseté, et me suis séparé de ma (propre) gestion, par Lui, dans le repousser et l'attirer.

bayts.text: رَضِيتُ بِهِ رَبًّا كَرِيمًا مُّكَرِّيمًا ۞ وَقَانِى الْعِدَى وَالْحَرْبَ وَالْبَحْرَ وَالتَّلْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Sono compiaciuto di Lui come Signore Generoso che onora: mi ha preservato dai nemici, dalla guerra, dal mare e dalla rovina.
translations.en.karamati: I am well pleased with Him as a Generous, honouring Lord: He protected me from enemies, war, the sea and ruin.
translations.fr.karamati: Je suis satisfait de Lui comme Seigneur Généreux qui honore : Il m'a préservé des ennemis, de la guerre, de la mer et de la ruine.

bayts.text: جَزَآءِى عَلَى الْمَوْلَى بِرَدِّى ذَوِالْفِرَى ۞ وَلِى وَجَّهُواْ مَالًا بِتَسْخِرِهِ سَلْبَا

translations.it.karamati: La mia ricompensa spetta al Signore, per il mio aver respinto i dotati di menzogne; e verso di me hanno volto beni, per la Sua sottomissione (di loro), senza spoliazione.
translations.en.karamati: My reward is with the Master, for my repelling the people of lies; and toward me they turned wealth, by His subjecting (them), without despoiling.
translations.fr.karamati: Ma récompense revient au Maître, pour avoir repoussé les détenteurs de mensonges ; et vers moi ils ont tourné des biens, par Sa soumission (d'eux), sans spoliation.

bayts.text: نِوَيْتُ هُنَا الرُّجْعَى لِطُوبَى بِإِذْنِهِ ۞ وَأَوْدَعْتُهُ جِسْمِى وَأَوْدَعْتُهُ الْقَلْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Ho inteso qui il ritorno a Ṭūbā (Touba), per il Suo permesso; e Gli ho affidato il mio corpo e Gli ho affidato il cuore.
translations.en.karamati: I have intended here the return to Ṭūbā (Touba), by His leave; and I have entrusted Him with my body and entrusted Him with the heart.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai eu l'intention ici du retour à Ṭūbā (Touba), par Sa permission ; et je Lui ai confié mon corps et Lui ai confié le cœur.

bayts.text: إِلَى اللَّهِ وَالْمُخْتَارِ هَاجَرْتُ مِنْ مَّلَا ۞ عِبَادَا تُهُمْ عِصْيَانُ رَبِّ أَلْوَرَى الْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Ad Allah e al Prescelto sono emigrato, da una moltitudine le cui adorazioni sono la disobbedienza al Signore del creato, la Grazia.
translations.en.karamati: To Allah and the Chosen have I emigrated, from a throng whose acts of worship are disobedience to the Lord of creation, the Gracious.
translations.fr.karamati: Vers Allah et l'Élu j'ai émigré, d'une foule dont les adorations sont la désobéissance au Seigneur de la création, la Grâce.

bayts.text: مَرَامِىَ يُعْطِينِهِ رَبٌّ مُّقَدِّمٌ ۞ قَدِيمٌ لَّهُ مُلْكٌ حَوَى الشَّرْقَ وَالْغَرْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Il mio scopo me lo dà un Signore che pone innanzi, Eterno, il Cui regno ha racchiuso l'oriente e l'occidente.
translations.en.karamati: My aim is granted me by a Lord Who brings forward, Eternal, Whose dominion has encompassed the east and the west.
translations.fr.karamati: Mon but, me le donne un Seigneur qui place en avant, Éternel, dont le royaume a renfermé l'orient et l'occident.

bayts.text: نَجَاتِى مِنَ الْأَعْدَآءِ وَالْبَحْرِ وَالْبَلَآ ۞ غَرِيبًا وَحِيدًا مِّنْ حَفِيظٍ مَّلَا الْجُرْبَا

translations.it.karamati: La mia salvezza dai nemici, dal mare e dalla prova, straniero, solitario, (è venuta) da un Custode che ha riempito le sacche (di provviste).
translations.en.karamati: My deliverance from enemies, the sea and trial, a stranger, alone, (came) from a Guardian Who filled the satchels.
translations.fr.karamati: Mon salut des ennemis, de la mer et de l'épreuve, étranger, solitaire, (est venu) d'un Gardien qui a rempli les besaces.

bayts.text: هَدَانِى تَعَالَى بَعْدَ مَا كِدْتُّ هَالِكًا ۞ بِجَاهِ الَّذِى قَدْ زَيَّنَ الْعُجْمَ وَالْعُرْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Mi ha guidato l'Altissimo dopo che ero quasi perito, per il prestigio di colui che ha ornato i non arabi e gli arabi.
translations.en.karamati: The Exalted guided me after I had nearly perished, by the standing of him who adorned non-Arabs and Arabs.
translations.fr.karamati: Le Très-Haut m'a guidé après que j'ai failli périr, par le prestige de celui qui a orné les non-Arabes et les Arabes.

bayts.text: أُنَاجِيهِ فِى سِرٍّ وَجَهْرٍ وَأَرْتَجِى ۞ صَلَاحِى وَإِصْلَاحِى بِهِ الْأَهْلَ وَالتِّرْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Gli parlo in intimità nel segreto e nel palese, e spero la mia rettitudine e il mio risanare, per mezzo di Lui, la famiglia e i coetanei.
translations.en.karamati: I converse with Him intimately in secret and openly, and I hope for my righteousness and my reforming, through Him, of family and peers.
translations.fr.karamati: Je Lui parle intimement en secret et ouvertement, et j'espère ma rectitude et mon redressement, par Lui, de la famille et des compagnons d'âge.

bayts.text: ذَلِلْتُ لَهُ لَا لِلْعِدَى ثُمَّ كَانَ لِى ۞ وَكَنْزِ كِتَابٌ حُبُّهُ يَكْشِفُ الْكَرْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Mi sono umiliato davanti a Lui, non davanti ai nemici; poi c'è stato per me, come tesoro, un Libro il cui amore svela l'angoscia.
translations.en.karamati: I humbled myself before Him, not before the enemies; then there was for me, as a treasure, a Book whose love dispels distress.
translations.fr.karamati: Je me suis humilié devant Lui, non devant les ennemis ; puis il y a eu pour moi, comme trésor, un Livre dont l'amour dévoile l'angoisse.

bayts.text: هَدَانِى بِهِ رَبِّى وَأَهْدِى بِنُورِهِ ۞ إِذَاشَآءَهُ رَبِّ ذَوِى الْبُعْدِ وَالْقُرْبَى

translations.it.karamati: Mi ha guidato per mezzo di esso il mio Signore, e io guido con la sua luce, quando il Signore lo vuole, i lontani e i vicini.
translations.en.karamati: My Lord guided me through it, and I guide by its light, when the Lord wills, the far and the near.
translations.fr.karamati: Mon Seigneur m'a guidé par lui, et je guide par sa lumière, quand le Seigneur le veut, les lointains et les proches.

bayts.text: إِلَاهِى إِلَى طُوبَاىَ قُدْنِى وَسَلِّمَنْ ۞ وَجُدْ بِامْتِنَانٍ ثَمَّ وَلْتُومِنِ التُّرْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Mio Dio, conducimi alla mia Ṭūbā (Touba) e preservami, ed elargisci con favore là, e metti al sicuro la terra.
translations.en.karamati: My God, lead me to my Ṭūbā (Touba) and keep me safe, and bestow favour there, and make the land secure.
translations.fr.karamati: Mon Dieu, conduis-moi à ma Ṭūbā (Touba) et préserve-moi, et octroie avec faveur là-bas, et mets en sécurité la terre.

bayts.text: لَكَ الْبَرُّ وَالْبَحْرُ الَّذِى قُدْ تَّنِى لَهُ ۞ قَفِى الْبَرِّ هَبْ لِى الْأَمْنَ وَلْتُكْرِمِ الْجَنبَا

translations.it.karamati: Tua è la terraferma e il mare, al quale mi hai condotto; sulla terraferma donami la sicurezza e onora il (mio) fianco.
translations.en.karamati: Yours are the land and the sea, to which You led me; on land grant me safety and honour (my) side.
translations.fr.karamati: À Toi la terre ferme et la mer, vers laquelle Tu m'as conduit ; sur la terre ferme accorde-moi la sécurité et honore (mon) flanc.

bayts.text: قُلُوبَ الْعِدَى قَلِّبْ إِلَى مَا يَسُرُّنِى ۞ وَبِى بَشِّرِ الْأَخْيَارَ وَلْتَغْفِرِ الذَّنبَا

translations.it.karamati: I cuori dei nemici volgi verso ciò che mi rallegra, e per mezzo di me annuncia la buona novella agli eletti, e perdona il peccato.
translations.en.karamati: Turn the hearts of the enemies toward what gladdens me, and through me give glad tidings to the elect, and forgive the sin.
translations.fr.karamati: Les cœurs des ennemis tourne-les vers ce qui me réjouit, et par moi annonce la bonne nouvelle aux élus, et pardonne le péché.

bayts.text: رَجَوْتُ فِرَاقِى سَرْمَدًا جُمْلَةَ الْعِدَى ۞ وَلُقْيَى عِيَالِى مِنْكَ يَامَنْ قَضَى الْأَرْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Ho sperato la mia separazione per sempre dall'insieme dei nemici, e l'incontro con la mia famiglia, da parte Tua, o Tu che hai soddisfatto i bisogni.
translations.en.karamati: I have hoped for my parting forever from all the enemies, and meeting my family, from You, O You Who fulfilled the needs.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai espéré ma séparation à jamais de l'ensemble des ennemis, et la rencontre avec ma famille, de Ta part, ô Toi qui as satisfait les besoins.

bayts.text: يُقَلِّبُ قَهْرٌ مِّنْكَ رَبِّ قُلُوبَهُمْ ۞ فَلِى كُنْ بِكُنْ رَّبِّ وَلِى وَسِّعِ الزِّرْبَا

translations.it.karamati: La Tua forza dominatrice, Signore, rovescia i loro cuori: sii dunque per me con «Sii», Signore, e allarga per me il recinto.
translations.en.karamati: Your subduing might, Lord, overturns their hearts: so be for me with "Be", Lord, and widen the enclosure for me.
translations.fr.karamati: Ta force dominatrice, Seigneur, retourne leurs cœurs : sois donc pour moi par « Sois », Seigneur, et élargis pour moi l'enclos.

bayts.text: تَفَضَّلْ عَلَىَّ الْيَوْمَ يَارَبِّ بِالْمُنَى ۞ بِفَتْحٍ وَفَيْضٍ يُخْجِلُ الْوَبْلَ مُنْصَبَّا

translations.it.karamati: Fammi grazia oggi, o Signore, dei desideri, con un'apertura e un'effusione che facciano arrossire l'acquazzone che si riversa.
translations.en.karamati: Favour me today, O Lord, with the wishes, with an opening and an outpouring that put the pouring downpour to shame.
translations.fr.karamati: Fais-moi grâce aujourd'hui, ô Seigneur, des souhaits, avec une ouverture et une effusion qui fassent rougir l'averse qui se déverse.

bayts.text: إِلَيْكَ وَلِلْمُخْتَارِ هَاجَرْتُ بِالْهُدَى ۞ وَبِالسُّنَّةِ الْبَيْضَآءِ يَامَنْ وَّقَى التَّبَّا

translations.it.karamati: A Te e al Prescelto sono emigrato con la retta guida e con la Sunna luminosa, o Tu che hai preservato dalla perdizione.
translations.en.karamati: To You and to the Chosen I emigrated with guidance and with the radiant Sunna, O You Who protected from perdition.
translations.fr.karamati: Vers Toi et vers l'Élu j'ai émigré avec la droite guidance et avec la Sunna lumineuse, ô Toi qui as préservé de la perdition.

bayts.text: لِىَ اصْرِقْ كُءُوسَ الْقَوْمِ وَلْتَسْقِنِى بِهَا ۞ وَوَسِّعْ وَهَبْ لِى الْمَصَّ يَارَبِّ وَالْعَبَّا

translations.it.karamati: Volgi verso di me le coppe del popolo (dei santi) e abbeverami con esse, e allarga e donami il sorso, o Signore, e il bere a lunghi sorsi.
translations.en.karamati: Turn toward me the cups of the folk (of saints) and give me to drink with them, and widen and grant me the sip, O Lord, and the deep draught.
translations.fr.karamati: Tourne vers moi les coupes du peuple (des saints) et abreuve-moi avec elles, et élargis et accorde-moi la gorgée, ô Seigneur, et la boisson à longs traits.

bayts.text: ظَلَامِىَ بِالْمِصْبَاحِ عَنِى جَلَوْتَهَا ۞ عَلَيْهِ صَلَاةٌ مِّنْكَ أَحْوِ بِهَا الْحُبَّا

translations.it.karamati: Le mie tenebre, con la Lampada (il Profeta), da me le hai dissipate — su di lui una benedizione da parte Tua — con la quale io racchiuda l'amore.
translations.en.karamati: My darknesses, by the Lamp (the Prophet), You dispelled from me — upon him a blessing from You — by which I may contain love.
translations.fr.karamati: Mes ténèbres, par la Lampe (le Prophète), de moi Tu les as dissipées — sur lui une bénédiction de Ta part — par laquelle je renferme l'amour.

bayts.text: أَزَلْتَ بِهِ كِبْرِى وَعُجْبِى مُرَبِّيًا ۞ عَلَيْهِ سَلَامٌ مِّنْكَ يَكْفِينِىَ الْخِبَّا

translations.it.karamati: Hai rimosso per mezzo di lui la mia superbia e il mio compiacimento di me, educando — su di lui un saluto di pace da parte Tua — che mi risparmi l'inganno.
translations.en.karamati: You removed through him my arrogance and my self-satisfaction, nurturing — upon him a peace from You — that spares me deceit.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu as écarté par lui mon orgueil et ma suffisance, en éduquant — sur lui un salut de paix de Ta part — qui m'épargne la fourberie.

bayts.text: لَقَدْ سُقْتَ لِى فِى الْبَحْرِ مَا كُنْتُ أَرْتَجِى ۞ بِجَاهِ الَّذِى صَيَّرْتَهُ الْخِلَّ وَالْحِبَّا

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai già sospinto nel mare ciò che speravo, per il prestigio di colui che hai reso l'intimo e l'amato.
translations.en.karamati: You have already driven to me at sea what I hoped for, by the standing of him whom You made the intimate and the beloved.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as déjà amené en mer ce que j'espérais, par le prestige de celui que Tu as fait l'intime et le bien-aimé.

bayts.text: مَحَوْتَ بِهِ عَيْبِى فَقُدْنِى مِنَ الْعِدَى ۞ إِلَى إِخْوَتِى وَاجْعَلْ رُجُوعِى لَنَا طِبَّا

translations.it.karamati: Hai cancellato per mezzo di lui il mio difetto: conducimi dunque via dai nemici verso i miei fratelli, e rendi il mio ritorno per noi un rimedio.
translations.en.karamati: You effaced my fault through him: so lead me away from the enemies to my brothers, and make my return a remedy for us.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu as effacé par lui mon défaut : conduis-moi donc loin des ennemis vers mes frères, et rends mon retour pour nous un remède.

bayts.text: أَجَرْتَ الَّذِى قَدْ كَانَ يَرْجُو إِجَارَةً ۞ فَزِدْهُ الْهُدَى وَالْعِلْمَ وَلْتَكْفِهِ الْعُجْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Hai dato protezione a colui che sperava protezione: accrescigli dunque la retta guida e la scienza, e risparmiagli il compiacimento di sé.
translations.en.karamati: You granted protection to the one who hoped for protection: so increase him in guidance and knowledge, and spare him self-conceit.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu as donné protection à celui qui espérait protection : accrois-lui donc la droite guidance et la science, et épargne-lui la suffisance.

bayts.text: هَدَيْتَ الَّذِى قَدْ كَانَ يُرْدِيهِ جَهْلَهُ ۞ فَعَنْهُ اكْشِفِ الْأَسْتَارَ يَارَبِّ وَالْحُجْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Hai guidato colui che la sua ignoranza stava per mandare in rovina: togli dunque da lui i veli, o Signore, e le cortine.
translations.en.karamati: You guided the one whom his ignorance was about to ruin: so remove from him the veils, O Lord, and the curtains.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu as guidé celui que son ignorance allait perdre : ôte donc de lui les voiles, ô Seigneur, et les rideaux.

bayts.text: لَكَ الشُّكْرُ وَالرِّضْوَانُ وَالْحَمْدُ سَرْمَدًا ۞ وَلَاشَكَّ لِى فِى كَوْنِكَ اللَّهَ وَالرَّبَّا

translations.it.karamati: A Te la gratitudine, il compiacimento e la lode per sempre, e non ho dubbio che Tu sia Allah e il Signore.
translations.en.karamati: To You be gratitude, good pleasure and praise forever, and I have no doubt that You are Allah and the Lord.
translations.fr.karamati: À Toi la gratitude, l'agrément et la louange à jamais, et je n'ai pas de doute que Tu sois Allah et le Seigneur.

bayts.text: هَجَرْتُ اللَّغَى بِالذِّكْرِ وَالشُّكْرِ مُثْنِيًا ۞ عَلَى الْمُصْطَفَى مَنْ جُودُهُ نَحْوِىَ انْصَبَّا

translations.it.karamati: Ho abbandonato la vanità con il ricordo e la gratitudine, lodando il Prescelto, colui la cui munificenza si è riversata verso di me.
translations.en.karamati: I forsook idle talk with remembrance and gratitude, praising the Chosen, he whose bounty has poured toward me.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai abandonné la vanité par le rappel et la gratitude, louant l'Élu, celui dont la munificence s'est déversée vers moi.

bayts.text: أَيَا اللَّهُ يَارَحْمَانُ يَامَنْ أَغَثْتَنِى ۞ فَصَلِّ بِتَسْلِيمٍ عَلَى خَيْرِ مَنْ لَّبَّى

translations.it.karamati: O Allah, o Compassionevole (Ar-Raḥmān), o Tu che mi hai soccorso: benedici dunque con il saluto di pace il migliore di coloro che hanno risposto «Labbayka».
translations.en.karamati: O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O You Who succoured me: so bless with peace the best of those who answered "Labbayka".
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Allah, ô Tout-Miséricordieux (Ar-Raḥmān), ô Toi qui m'as secouru : bénis donc avec le salut de paix le meilleur de ceux qui ont répondu « Labbayka ».

bayts.text: وَثِقْتُ وَكُنْ لِّى بِالْمُقَفَّى وَءَالِهِ ۞ وَأَصْحَابِهِ مَنْ أَخْجَلُواْ اللَّيْثَ إِذْ قَبَّا

translations.it.karamati: Ho avuto fiducia: sii per me, per mezzo del Seguito (al-Muqaffā), della sua Famiglia e dei suoi Compagni, coloro che hanno fatto arrossire il leone quando ruggiva.
translations.en.karamati: I have trusted: be for me, through the Followed (al-Muqaffā), his Family and his Companions, those who put the lion to shame when it roared.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai eu confiance : sois pour moi, par le Suivi (al-Muqaffā), sa Famille et ses Compagnons, ceux qui ont fait rougir le lion quand il rugissait.

bayts.text: أُنِيلُواْ ثَوَابَ اللَّهِ فِى كُلِّ غَزْوَةٍ ۞ مَعَ الْحُبِّ وَرِضْوَانِ وَالْقُرْبِ وَالْقُرْبَى

translations.it.karamati: È stata loro concessa la ricompensa di Allah in ogni spedizione, con l'amore, il compiacimento, la vicinanza e la parentela.
translations.en.karamati: They were granted the reward of Allah in every campaign, with love, good pleasure, nearness and kinship.
translations.fr.karamati: Il leur a été accordé la récompense d'Allah en chaque expédition, avec l'amour, l'agrément, la proximité et la parenté.

bayts.text: جِهَادَهُمُ الْأَعْمَالُ حَقًّا وَكُلُّهُمْ ۞ يُبَشِّرُهُ الْمَاحِى إِذَا عَايَنَ الْحَرْبَا

translations.it.karamati: La loro lotta (jihād) sono le opere, in verità, e ciascuno di loro il Cancellatore (al-Māḥī) lo rallegra con la buona novella quando ha visto la guerra.
translations.en.karamati: Their struggle (jihād) is deeds, in truth, and each of them the Effacer (al-Māḥī) gladdens with tidings when he faced war.
translations.fr.karamati: Leur lutte (jihād), ce sont les œuvres, en vérité, et chacun d'eux l'Effaceur (al-Māḥī) le réjouit de la bonne nouvelle quand il a vu la guerre.

bayts.text: عَلَيْهِمْ مِّنَ الْمَوْلَى رِضَآءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ ۞ كَمَا زَحْزَحُواْ عَنِّى بِأَسْيَافِهِمْ تَغْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Su di loro, da parte del Signore, compiacimento e misericordia, come hanno rimosso da me, con le loro spade, la sventura.
translations.en.karamati: Upon them, from the Master, good pleasure and mercy, as they removed misfortune from me with their swords.
translations.fr.karamati: Sur eux, de la part du Maître, agrément et miséricorde, comme ils ont écarté de moi, par leurs épées, le malheur.

bayts.text: لِىَ اجْعَلْ بِهِمْ يَا مَالِكِى خَيْرَ مَخْرَجٍ ۞ وَطَيِّبْ وَسَلِّمْ وَامْنُنَنْ وَّلْتَزِدْ رَغْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Per mezzo di loro, o mio Re, rendi per me la migliore uscita, e rendi buono, preserva, concedi favore e accresci il desiderio.
translations.en.karamati: Through them, O my King, make for me the best way out, and make good, preserve, grant favour and increase longing.
translations.fr.karamati: Par eux, ô mon Roi, fais pour moi la meilleure issue, et rends bon, préserve, accorde faveur et accrois le désir.

bayts.text: لَهُ اكْتُبْ صَلَاةً مَّعْ سَلَامٍ بِهِمْ مَّعًا ۞ وَهَبْ لِى بِهِمْ يَا مَالِكِى الطَّىَّ وَالْجَذْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Scrivi per lui una benedizione con un saluto di pace, per mezzo di loro insieme, e donami per mezzo di loro, o mio Re, l'accorciamento (del cammino) e l'attrazione (divina).
translations.en.karamati: Write for him a blessing with peace, through them together, and grant me through them, O my King, the folding (of the path) and the (divine) attraction.
translations.fr.karamati: Écris pour lui une bénédiction avec un salut de paix, par eux ensemble, et accorde-moi par eux, ô mon Roi, le raccourcissement (du chemin) et l'attraction (divine).

bayts.text: نَبَذْتُ الَّذِى قَدْ بِعْتُهُ فَلْتُبَدِّلَنْ ۞ وَجَنِّبْنِىَ الْإِعْجَابَ وَالْكِبْرَ وَالْكِذْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Ho rigettato ciò che ho venduto: sostituiscilo dunque (con il meglio), e tienimi lontano dal compiacimento di me, dalla superbia e dalla menzogna.
translations.en.karamati: I have cast away what I sold: so replace it (with better), and keep me far from self-conceit, arrogance and lying.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai rejeté ce que j'ai vendu : remplace-le donc (par le meilleur), et tiens-moi éloigné de la suffisance, de l'orgueil et du mensonge.

bayts.text: إِنِلْنِى كَرَامَاتٍ وَكُنْ لِّى بِالَانْتِهَا ۞ بِمَا فَاقَ ظَنِّى وَلْتُسَخِّرْ لِىَ الصَّعْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Fammi conseguire prodigi (karāmāt), e sii per me senza fine con ciò che supera la mia stima, e sottomettimi il difficile.
translations.en.karamati: Grant me charisms (karāmāt), and be for me without end with what surpasses my expectation, and subject the difficult to me.
translations.fr.karamati: Fais-moi obtenir des prodiges (karāmāt), et sois pour moi sans fin par ce qui dépasse mon estime, et soumets-moi le difficile.

bayts.text: مَدَدْتُّ يَدِى يَامَالِكِى رَاجِيًا لَّكُمْ ۞ غَرِيبًا مُّنِيبًا أَنِّسَنْ وَاكْشِف الرُّعْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Ho teso la mia mano, o mio Re, sperando in Voi, straniero, contrito: dammi conforto e allontana lo spavento.
translations.en.karamati: I have stretched out my hand, O my King, hoping in You, a stranger, penitent: grant me comfort and lift the terror.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai tendu ma main, ô mon Roi, espérant en Vous, étranger, contrit : donne-moi réconfort et écarte l'effroi.

bayts.text: نَفَيْتَ الْأَذَى عَنِّى فَجُدْ لِى بِأَوْبَتِى ۞ سَرِيعًا بِلَا كَدٍّ وَلِى وَسِّعِ اللَّحْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Hai respinto il nocumento da me: elargiscimi dunque il mio ritorno, rapido, senza fatica, e allarga per me la via.
translations.en.karamati: You have repelled harm from me: so grant me my return, swift, without toil, and widen the road for me.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu as repoussé le dommage de moi : octroie-moi donc mon retour, rapide, sans fatigue, et élargis pour moi la voie.

bayts.text: لَكَ الشُّكْرُ إِذْ صَيَّرْ تَنِى خَادِمَ النَّبِى ۞ عَلَيْهِ صَلَاةٌ مِّنْكَ تُعْلِى بِهَا الصَّحْبَا

translations.it.karamati: A Te la gratitudine, poiché mi hai reso servitore del Profeta — su di lui una benedizione da parte Tua — con la quale elevi i Compagni.
translations.en.karamati: To You be gratitude, since You made me the servant of the Prophet — upon him a blessing from You — by which You exalt the Companions.
translations.fr.karamati: À Toi la gratitude, puisque Tu m'as fait serviteur du Prophète — sur lui une bénédiction de Ta part — par laquelle Tu élèves les Compagnons.

bayts.text: دَعَوْتُكَ بِالْمُخْتَارِ بِالْئَالِ كُلِّهِمْ ۞ وَأَصْحَابِهِ يَامَنْ كَفَانِى بِهِمْ شِصْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Ti ho invocato per mezzo del Prescelto, per mezzo di tutta la Famiglia e dei suoi Compagni, o Tu che per mezzo di loro mi hai risparmiato l'avversità.
translations.en.karamati: I have called upon You through the Chosen, through all the Family and his Companions, O You Who through them spared me adversity.
translations.fr.karamati: Je T'ai invoqué par l'Élu, par toute la Famille et ses Compagnons, ô Toi qui par eux m'as épargné l'adversité.

bayts.text: نَفَيْتَ بِهِمْ عَنِّى الْأَذَى ثُمَّ كُنْتَ لِى ۞ فَلِى طَيِّبِ الرُّجْعَى وَلِى خَلِّدِ الْخِصْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Hai respinto per mezzo di loro il nocumento da me, poi sei stato per me: rendi dunque buono per me il ritorno e rendi eterna per me l'abbondanza.
translations.en.karamati: You repelled harm from me through them, then You were for me: so make the return good for me and make plenty eternal for me.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu as repoussé par eux le dommage de moi, puis Tu as été pour moi : rends donc bon pour moi le retour et rends éternelle pour moi l'abondance.

bayts.text: كَفَيْتَ ذَوِالتَّثْلِيثِ عَنِّى وَأَدْبَرُواْ ۞ فُرَدِى وَمَثْنِى وَاكْفِنِيهِمْ بِهِمْ دَاْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai risparmiato i fautori della Trinità, ed essi si sono volti indietro, a uno a uno e a due a due: risparmiameli per mezzo di loro sempre.
translations.en.karamati: You spared me the upholders of the Trinity, and they turned back, singly and in pairs: spare me them through them always.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as épargné les tenants de la Trinité, et ils ont tourné le dos, un à un et deux à deux : épargne-les-moi par eux toujours.

bayts.text: وَثِقْتُ بِكَ اللَّهُمَّ سُوْلِى مَرَاغِبِى ۞ دَوَامًا بِجَاهِ الْمُصْطَفَى وَاكْفِنِى الْكَأْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Ho avuto fiducia in Te, o Allah, (per) la mia richiesta e i miei desideri, perennemente, per il prestigio del Prescelto; e risparmiami l'afflizione.
translations.en.karamati: I have trusted in You, O Allah, (for) my request and my desires, perpetually, by the standing of the Chosen; and spare me grief.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai eu confiance en Toi, ô Allah, (pour) ma demande et mes désirs, perpétuellement, par le prestige de l'Élu ; et épargne-moi l'affliction.

bayts.text: لَهُ اكْتُبْ صَلَاةً مَّعْ سَلَامٍ بِئَالِهِ ۞ وَأَصْحَابِهِ وَاجْعَلْ بِهِ مَسْجِدِ رَحْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Scrivi per lui una benedizione con un saluto di pace, con la sua Famiglia e i suoi Compagni, e rendi per mezzo di lui la mia moschea spaziosa.
translations.en.karamati: Write for him a blessing with peace, with his Family and his Companions, and make my mosque spacious through him.
translations.fr.karamati: Écris pour lui une bénédiction avec un salut de paix, avec sa Famille et ses Compagnons, et rends par lui ma mosquée spacieuse.

bayts.text: يُبَشِّرُهُ ظَنِّى الَّذِى قَادَنِى إِلَى ۞ دُعَآءٍ فَبَشِّرْ مَنْ أَطَالُواْ لِىَ النَّحْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Gli annuncia la buona novella la mia buona opinione (di Dio), che mi ha condotto all'invocazione: annuncia dunque la buona novella a chi ha prolungato per me il pianto.
translations.en.karamati: My good opinion (of God) gives him glad tidings, which led me to supplication: so give glad tidings to whoever prolonged weeping for me.
translations.fr.karamati: Lui annonce la bonne nouvelle ma bonne opinion (de Dieu), qui m'a conduit à l'invocation : annonce donc la bonne nouvelle à qui a prolongé pour moi les pleurs.

bayts.text: يُبَشِّرُهُ عِلْمِ بِكَوْنِكَ قَادِرًا ۞ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ لِّى اسْتَجِبْ وَالْفِنِى النَّكْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Gli annuncia la buona novella la mia scienza del Tuo essere Potente su ogni cosa: esaudiscimi e risparmiami la sventura.
translations.en.karamati: My knowledge of Your being Powerful over all things gives him glad tidings: answer me and spare me calamity.
translations.fr.karamati: Lui annonce la bonne nouvelle ma science de Ton être Puissant sur toute chose : exauce-moi et épargne-moi le malheur.

bayts.text: أَجِبْ دَعْوَتِى وَجِّهْ قُيُوضًا لِّكَلْكَلِى ۞ وَخَلِّدْ فُيُوضَاتِى وَلَا تَتْرُكِ السَّكْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Esaudisci la mia invocazione, volgi effusioni verso ogni mia parte, e rendi eterne le mie effusioni e non tralasciare il versare.
translations.en.karamati: Answer my supplication, turn outpourings toward all of me, and make my outpourings eternal and do not leave off the pouring.
translations.fr.karamati: Exauce mon invocation, tourne des effusions vers toutes mes parties, et rends éternelles mes effusions et ne délaisse pas le déversement.

bayts.text: وَثِقْتُ بِبَاقٍ قَاهِرٍ قَادِرٍ لَّهُ ۞ فُؤَادِى وَجُثْمَانِى وَلِى يَقْبَلُ الْكِسْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Ho avuto fiducia in un Permanente, Soggiogatore, Potente, al Quale appartengono il mio cuore e il mio corpo, e che accoglie per me il guadagno.
translations.en.karamati: I have trusted in an Everlasting, Subduing, Powerful One, to Whom belong my heart and my body, and Who accepts my earning for me.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai eu confiance en un Permanent, Dominateur, Puissant, à Qui appartiennent mon cœur et mon corps, et qui accueille pour moi le gain.

bayts.text: أُدِيمُ لَهُ مَاعِشْتُ إِنْ شَآ عِبَادَةً ۞ وَأَرْجُو قَبُولًا مِّنْهُ قَدْتُّورِثُ الْوِسْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Gli renderò perenne, finché vivrò, se Egli vuole, l'adorazione, e spero da Lui un'accettazione che faccia ereditare l'abbondanza.
translations.en.karamati: I shall keep up for Him, as long as I live, if He wills, worship, and I hope from Him an acceptance that bequeaths abundance.
translations.fr.karamati: Je Lui rendrai pérenne, tant que je vivrai, s'Il le veut, l'adoration, et j'espère de Lui une acceptation qui fasse hériter l'abondance.

bayts.text: جَعَلْتُ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ وِرْدِى وَأَبْتَغِى ۞ بِتَرْتِيلِهِ مَا شِأْتُ إِصَارَ لِى أَبَّا

translations.it.karamati: Ho reso il Libro di Allah la mia recitazione quotidiana, e cerco, con la sua recitazione lenta, ciò che ho voluto, come stabile pascolo per me.
translations.en.karamati: I have made the Book of Allah my daily litany, and I seek, by reciting it slowly, what I have willed, as a lasting pasture for me.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai fait du Livre d'Allah ma récitation quotidienne, et je recherche, par sa récitation posée, ce que j'ai voulu, comme pâturage stable pour moi.

bayts.text: عَلَىَّ لِرَبِّى دَيْنُ تَرْتِيلِ ءَايِهِ ۞ وَإِنِّى إِلَى قَوْمِى أَءُوبُ بِهِ أَبَّا

translations.it.karamati: Ho verso il mio Signore il debito della recitazione lenta dei Suoi versetti, e io torno al mio popolo con essa, come pascolo.
translations.en.karamati: I owe my Lord the debt of slow recitation of His verses, and I return to my people with it, as pasture.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai envers mon Seigneur la dette de la récitation posée de Ses versets, et je retourne à mon peuple avec elle, comme pâturage.

bayts.text: لِرَبِّىَ أَحْمَدِى ثُمَّ شُكْرِ بِلَا انْتِهًا ۞ عَلَى جَعْلِ صَدْرِ ظَرْفَ ءَايَاتِهِ حِزْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Al mio Signore la mia lode e poi la gratitudine senza fine, per aver reso il mio petto ricettacolo dei Suoi versetti, a porzioni (ḥizb).
translations.en.karamati: To my Lord be my praise and then gratitude without end, for making my breast the vessel of His verses, portion by portion (ḥizb).
translations.fr.karamati: À mon Seigneur ma louange puis la gratitude sans fin, pour avoir fait de ma poitrine le réceptacle de Ses versets, par portions (ḥizb).

bayts.text: لَهُ جَلَّ شُكْرِى بَعْدَ حَمْدِ وَكَانَ لِى ۞ وَلِى رَاضَ أَعْدَآءً نَحَوْا جَانِبِى حِزْبَا

translations.it.karamati: A Lui — sia esaltato — la mia gratitudine dopo la lode; ed Egli è stato per me, e ha domato per me nemici che, in schiera, si erano diretti verso la mia parte.
translations.en.karamati: To Him — exalted be He — be my gratitude after praise; and He has been for me, and tamed for me enemies who, in a band, had made for my side.
translations.fr.karamati: À Lui — qu'Il soit exalté — ma gratitude après la louange ; et Il a été pour moi, et a dompté pour moi des ennemis qui, en troupe, s'étaient dirigés vers mon côté.

bayts.text: نَجَوْتُ بِحِفْظِ اللَّهِ مِنْ سَطْوَةِ الْعِدَى ۞ وَلِى رَاضَهُمْ طُرًا وَلِى كَرَّمَ الْجَنْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Mi sono salvato, per la custodia di Allah, dall'assalto dei nemici, ed Egli li ha domati tutti per me, e ha onorato per me il fianco.
translations.en.karamati: I was saved, by the keeping of Allah, from the onslaught of the enemies, and He tamed them all for me, and honoured my side.
translations.fr.karamati: Je me suis sauvé, par la garde d'Allah, de l'assaut des ennemis, et Il les a tous domptés pour moi, et a honoré pour moi le flanc.

bayts.text: أَغَاثَنِىَ الْحَنَّانُ مِنْ كَيْدِ مَنْ قَلَى ۞ وَصَارَ كَنَارِ الْخِلِّ لِى بَحْرُ مَايُنبَا

translations.it.karamati: Mi ha soccorso il Tenero (Al-Ḥannān) dall'insidia di chi ha odiato, e il mare è divenuto per me, come il fuoco dell'Intimo (Abramo, Corano 21:69), qualcosa che non nuoce.
translations.en.karamati: The Tender (Al-Ḥannān) succoured me from the plot of whoever hated, and the sea became for me, like the fire of the Intimate Friend (Abraham, Qurʾān 21:69), a thing that does not harm.
translations.fr.karamati: Le Tendre (Al-Ḥannān) m'a secouru de la ruse de qui a haï, et la mer est devenue pour moi, comme le feu de l'Intime (Abraham, Coran 21:69), une chose qui ne nuit pas.

bayts.text: مِدَادِى وَأَقْلَامِى وَلَوْحِى وَكَلْكَلِى ۞ وَجِسْمِى لِمَنْ لِّى وَجَّهَ الْحِفْظَا وَالْوَهْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Il mio inchiostro, le mie penne, la mia tavoletta, ogni mia parte e il mio corpo sono per Colui che ha volto verso di me la custodia e il dono.
translations.en.karamati: My ink, my pens, my tablet, all of me and my body belong to Him Who turned keeping and gift toward me.
translations.fr.karamati: Mon encre, mes plumes, ma tablette, toutes mes parties et mon corps sont pour Celui qui a tourné vers moi la garde et le don.

bayts.text: نَوَيْتُ لَهُ شُكْرًا كَثِيرًا كَمَا حَمَى ۞ جَنَابِى وَأَسْتَكْفِيهِ يَوْمَ الْجَوَى اللَّهْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Ho inteso per Lui una gratitudine abbondante, come Egli ha protetto la mia parte, e Gli chiedo di risparmiarmi, il giorno dell'ardore, la fiamma.
translations.en.karamati: I have intended for Him abundant gratitude, as He protected my side, and I ask Him to spare me, on the day of burning, the flame.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai eu l'intention pour Lui d'une gratitude abondante, comme Il a protégé mon côté, et je Lui demande de m'épargner, au jour de l'ardeur, la flamme.

bayts.text: لَهُ جَلَّ شُكْرِى إِذْ هَدَانِى بِفَضْلِهِ ۞ وَجَاهِ الَّذِى مَدْحِى لَهُ صَارَ لِى عَضْبَا

translations.it.karamati: A Lui — sia esaltato — la mia gratitudine, poiché mi ha guidato per la Sua grazia e per il prestigio di colui il cui elogio da parte mia è divenuto per me una spada tagliente.
translations.en.karamati: To Him — exalted be He — be my gratitude, since He guided me by His grace and by the standing of him whose praise by me has become for me a cutting sword.
translations.fr.karamati: À Lui — qu'Il soit exalté — ma gratitude, puisqu'Il m'a guidé par Sa grâce et par le prestige de celui dont l'éloge de ma part est devenu pour moi une épée tranchante.

bayts.text: دَعَانِى إِلَى دَارِ السَّلَامِ الَّتِى بِهَا ۞ أُنَاجِيهِ بِالذِّكْرِ الَّذِى طَيَّبَ الْقَلْبِا

translations.it.karamati: Mi ha chiamato alla Dimora della Pace (Corano 10:25), nella quale Gli parlo in intimità con il ricordo che ha reso buono il cuore.
translations.en.karamati: He called me to the Abode of Peace (Qurʾān 10:25), in which I converse with Him intimately with the remembrance that made the heart good.
translations.fr.karamati: Il m'a appelé à la Demeure de la Paix (Coran 10:25), en laquelle je Lui parle intimement par le rappel qui a rendu bon le cœur.

bayts.text: نَفَى عَنِّىَ الشَّيْطَانَ وَلَّى بِكَيْدِهِ ۞ وَأَبْغِى نَجَاةً مِّنْهُ مِنْهُ مَتِى دَبَّا

translations.it.karamati: Ha respinto da me Satana, che si è volto indietro con la sua insidia; e cerco salvezza da lui, (presso) di Lui, quando si insinua.
translations.en.karamati: He repelled Satan from me, who turned back with his plot; and I seek salvation from him, (with) Him, whenever he creeps.
translations.fr.karamati: Il a repoussé de moi Satan, qui a tourné le dos avec sa ruse ; et je cherche le salut contre lui, (auprès) de Lui, quand il s'insinue.

bayts.text: كَفَانِى حَفِيظٌ قَاهِرٌ مَّانِعٌ هُنَا ۞ شُكُوكًا وَوَسْوَاسًا وَعَنِّى الْعِدَى ذَبَّا

translations.it.karamati: Mi ha risparmiato un Custode, Soggiogatore, Impeditore, qui, dubbi e sussurri, e da me ha respinto i nemici.
translations.en.karamati: A Guardian, Subduer, Preventer has spared me, here, doubts and whisperings, and driven the enemies from me.
translations.fr.karamati: M'a épargné un Gardien, Dominateur, Empêcheur, ici, doutes et chuchotements, et de moi Il a repoussé les ennemis.

bayts.text: نَوَيْتُ رُجُوعًا ذَا صَلَاةٍ مُّسَلِّمًا ۞ عَلَى الْمُصْطَفَى الْمَاحِى الَّذِى اخْتَارَهُ حِبَّا

translations.it.karamati: Ho inteso un ritorno dotato di benedizione, salutando con pace il Prescelto, il Cancellatore, che Egli ha scelto come amato.
translations.en.karamati: I have intended a return endowed with blessing, greeting with peace the Chosen, the Effacer, whom He chose as beloved.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai eu l'intention d'un retour doté de bénédiction, saluant de paix l'Élu, l'Effaceur, qu'Il a choisi comme bien-aimé.

bayts.text: صَلَاةٌ وَتَسْلِيمٌ عَلَى الْمُصْطَفَى النَّبِى ۞ مَعَ الْئَالِ وَالْأَصْحَابِ مِمَّنْ نَّفَى الْخِبَّا

translations.it.karamati: Benedizione e saluto di pace sul Prescelto, il Profeta, con la Famiglia e i Compagni, (da parte) di Colui che ha respinto l'inganno.
translations.en.karamati: Blessing and peace upon the Chosen, the Prophet, with the Family and the Companions, (from) Him Who repelled deceit.
translations.fr.karamati: Bénédiction et salut de paix sur l'Élu, le Prophète, avec la Famille et les Compagnons, (de la part) de Celui qui a repoussé la fourberie.

bayts.text: يُصَلِّى بِتَسْلِيمٍ عَلَيْهِ بِئَالِهِ ۞ وَأَصْحَابِهِ رَبٌّ حَفِيظٌ كَفَى تَبَّا

translations.it.karamati: Lo benedica con il saluto di pace, con la sua Famiglia e i suoi Compagni, un Signore Custode che ha risparmiato la perdizione,
translations.en.karamati: May a Lord, a Guardian Who spared perdition, bless him with peace, with his Family and his Companions,
translations.fr.karamati: Que le bénisse avec le salut de paix, avec sa Famille et ses Compagnons, un Seigneur Gardien qui a épargné la perdition,

bayts.text: رَحِيمٌ شَكُورٌ أَرْتَجِى مِنْهُ رَفْعَهُ ۞ إِلَيْهِ مَكَاتِيبِى وَأَكْرِمْ بِهِ رَبَّا

translations.it.karamati: Misericordioso, Riconoscente, dal Quale spero che innalzi a Sé i miei scritti; e quanto è generoso Egli come Signore!
translations.en.karamati: Merciful, Appreciative, from Whom I hope He will raise my writings to Himself; and how generous He is as Lord!
translations.fr.karamati: Très-Miséricordieux, Reconnaissant, de Qui j'espère qu'Il élève vers Lui mes écrits ; et combien Il est généreux comme Seigneur !

bayts.text: أُصَلِّى بِتَسْلِيمٍ عَلَيْهِ لِوَجْهِ مَنْ ۞ يَّسُوقُ بِهِ لِى مَااعْتَمَى لِى كَمَا رَبَّى

translations.it.karamati: Lo benedico con il saluto di pace, per il Volto di Colui che per mezzo di lui mi sospinge ciò che ha scelto per me, come mi ha educato.
translations.en.karamati: I bless him with peace, for the Countenance of Him Who through him drives to me what He chose for me, as He has nurtured me.
translations.fr.karamati: Je le bénis avec le salut de paix, pour la Face de Celui qui par lui m'amène ce qu'Il a choisi pour moi, comme Il m'a éduqué.
